message: Historical EMI data import (95 borrowers, 101 loans from the pre-existing paper register, due-20th and due-30th batches) plus a new business rule: a partial EMI payment (paid, but less than due) no longer disappears into a flat fine -- its shortfall carries forward and is added onto next month's due amount, compounding until the loan closes, at which point any leftover is handled like the existing fine/penalty Collect-or-Waive step; an overpayment works the same way in reverse, reducing what's due next. Late fine no longer applies to a partial payment, only to a fully missed one. Credit Rating now shows 'New' for a borrower with no repayment history yet, and a run of consecutive partial-payment months costs 1 point for the first, 2 for the second, 3 for the third and so on (never below 0), resetting the moment a month is paid in full. Fixed a real bug where the Credit Rating detail popup was listing installments that aren't even due yet as 'missed' -- future installments are now correctly left out of scoring entirely until their due date arrives. Added a standalone '+ Add New Borrower' and '+ Add New Loan' button above the Borrowers and Loans search cards, so adding someone new no longer requires running a search/filter first.
